name: Clay Furniture Industries
old_description: Since 1981 Clay Furniture has focused on producing commercial cabinetry solutions for a wealth of customers large and small, both locally and nationally. We serve direct customer relationships, general contractors, architects, and interior designers, from our 18,000/sf facility located in Hartford, CT.
about:
Clay Furniture Industries, founded in 1981 by Richard and Julie Clay, is based in Manchester, Connecticut. The company operates an 18,000-square-foot production facility in nearby Hartford. In recent years, Drew Hodgdon and Brandon Knowlden acquired the business and continue its original focus on commercial cabinetry and millwork.

The firm provides commercial cabinetry, custom millwork, and design-build services from a single location. Its capabilities include shop drawing preparation, estimating, and fabrication in laminate, solid surface, and various wood species. The design-build model consolidates design and manufacturing under one roof, serving clients who lack an in-house architect or designer.

Clay Furniture serves general contractors, subcontractors, architects, interior designers, and direct commercial clients across education, hospitality, healthcare, state and local government, and corporate environments. Project types range from classrooms and laboratories to dental offices, medical exam rooms, reception areas, and retail spaces.

The company emphasizes its integrated design-build approach and material versatility as key differentiators, aiming to deliver cohesion and efficiency for projects that require custom millwork solutions.
